## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the problem, what this changes, and the affected subsystem. Link relevant issues or approved change requests.

## Scope

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the applicable architecture, contracts, and ownership/change-control rules.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented functionality from planned capabilities.

## Validation

List the commands run and results, including failures, ignored tests, and checks not run with reasons. For Rust changes, include the relevant workspace build, formatting, check, test, and Clippy results from CONTRIBUTING.md. Describe meaningful behavior tests where applicable.

## Security

- [ ] No credentials, private keys, private user data, or sensitive vulnerability details are included.
- [ ] Security implications were considered; sensitive concerns were reported through SECURITY.md's private channel.

## Licensing and provenance

- [ ] I have the necessary rights to submit this contribution under Apache 2.0, or I have clearly identified any different terms for maintainer review.
- [ ] Imported/copied material is identified with its origin, license, and required notices; existing attribution is preserved.

Describe any new dependencies or provenance questions. AI-assisted work needs the same rights and licensing review as other contributions.
